id: # lane: front (arrives at ship height) or sky (arrives above).
# behavior: hold = sits and shoots. thief = dives for floating loot and flies off with it
name: drops it if killed. charger = winds up then rams the front car of one of its rows.

id: # armor: flat damage taken off every hit (a hit always does at least 1).
# target_rows: rows a front enemy may hit (0 top
name: 2 bottom)
emoji: separated by |. It hits the leftmost car in that row.

id: # target_cols: columns a sky enemy may hit (0 front
name: 2 rear). It hits the topmost car in that column.

id: # charge_dmg: damage of a ram. charge_break: damage you must deal during the wind-up to interrupt it.
# stay_s: seconds before it leaves with its cargo. 0 = never leaves (bosses).
